  return chain;
});

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const info = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const clickables = [...document.querySelectorAll('[onclick]')]
    .map(e => ({ tag: e.tagName, cls: e.className, onclick: e.getAttribute('onclick').slice(0,120), text: e.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ').slice(0,120) }))
    .filter(e => /pick|select|choose|queue|row|rca|open/i.test(e.onclick));
  const uniq = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const c of clickables) { const k = c.onclick.split('(')[0]+c.cls; if(!seen.has(k)){seen.add(k); uniq.push(c);} }
  return { total: clickables.length, sample: uniq.slice(0,25) };
});

investigate-root-cause-israel-euc-chat

53 actions · 53.5s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");

// instrument fetch to record RCA calls
await page.evaluate(() => {
  if (!window.__rcaCalls) {
    window.__rcaCalls = [];
    const of = window.fetch;
    window.fetch = async function (...args) {
      const url = typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : (args[0] && args[0].url);
      const t0 = Date.now();
      try {
        const r = await of.apply(this, args);
        if (/rca-investigate/.test(url || '')) window.__rcaCalls.push({ url, status: r.status, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
        return r;
      } catch (e) {
        if (/rca-investigate/.test(url || '')) window.__rcaCalls.push({ url, status: 'NETWORK_ERROR:' + String(e), ms: Date.now() - t0 });
        throw e;
      }
    };
  }
});

const btnInfo = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/.test(x.innerText));
  return b ? b.getAttribute('onclick') : null;
});
console.log("INVESTIGATE BUTTON ONCLICK:", btnInfo);

let usedFallback = false;
try {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Investigate Root Cause/ }).click({ timeout: 6000 });
  console.log("native pointer click on Investigate: OK");
} catch (e) {
  usedFallback = true;
  console.log("native pointer click on Investigate FAILED:", String(e).split("\n")[0]);
  await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/.test(x.innerText)).click());
  console.log("fallback element.click(): done");
}
console.log("USED_FALLBACK:", usedFallback);

// poll up to 150s for Engine: footer
let engine = null, elapsed = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  elapsed += 2;
  engine = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const t = document.getElementById('report') ? document.getElementById('report').innerText : document.body.innerText;
    const m = t.match(/Engine:[^\n]*/);
    return m ? m[0] : null;
  });
  if (engine) { console.log("ENGINE LINE APPEARED AFTER ~" + elapsed + "s"); break; }
}
if (!engine) console.log("FAIL: no Engine: line after " + elapsed + "s");

const calls = await page.evaluate(() => JSON.stringify(window.__rcaCalls || []));
console.log("RCA CALLS:", calls);
console.log("ENGINE LINE VERBATIM:", engine);
const rep = await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('report').innerText);
console.log("---- FULL REPORT TEXT ----");
console.log(rep);
await writeFile("inv1.txt", rep);

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('#report *')].find(e => /^Engine:/.test(e.textContent.trim()) && e.children.length === 0);
  if (t) t.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
});
await page.waitForTimeout(800);
const r = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const txt = document.getElementById('report').innerText;
  const g = (re) => { const m = txt.match(re); return m ? m[0] : null; };
  return {
    engine: g(/Engine:[^\n]*/),
    causeType: g(/(?:Forecast baseline error|Cause type[^\n]*)/),
    confidence: (txt.match(/(\d+)% confidence · (High|Medium|Low)/g) || []),
    proof: g(/Forecast \(fcst_offered\)[^\n]*/) + " || " + g(/Actual demand \(Actual_Offered\)[^\n]*/),
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 1));
const isLlm = /Engine:\s*llm\s*·\s*nvidia\//.test(r.engine || "");
console.log(isLlm ? "PASS: Engine is llm with an NVIDIA model" : "FAIL: Engine is not llm/nvidia -> " + r.engine);

  console.log("native pointer click on Investigate FAILED:", String(e).split("\n")[0]);
  await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/.test(x.innerText)).click());
  console.log("fallback element.click(): done");
}
console.log("USED_FALLBACK:", usedFallback);

let engine = null, elapsed = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  elapsed += 2;
  const st = await page.evaluate((n) => {
    const t = document.getElementById('report').innerText;
    const m = t.match(/Engine:[^\n]*/);
    return { engine: m ? m[0] : null, calls: (window.__rcaCalls || []).length };
  }, before);
  if (st.calls > before && st.engine) { engine = st.engine; console.log("ENGINE LINE APPEARED AFTER ~" + elapsed + "s"); break; }
}
if (!engine) console.log("FAIL: no new Engine: line after " + elapsed + "s");
console.log("RCA CALLS (all):", await page.evaluate(() => JSON.stringify(window.__rcaCalls || [])));
console.log("ENGINE LINE VERBATIM:", engine);
const rep = await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('report').innerText);
console.log("---- FULL REPORT TEXT ----");
console.log(rep);

  const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('#report *')].find(e => /^Engine:/.test(e.textContent.trim()) && e.children.length === 0);

});

  const g = re => { const m = txt.match(re); return m ? m[0] : null; };
  return { engine: g(/Engine:[^\n]*/), missing: txt.split("MISSING INFORMATION")[1] };
});

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
let fb1 = false;
try { await page.locator('.qitem >> nth=4').click({ timeout: 5000 }); console.log("queue native click OK"); }
catch (e) { fb1 = true; await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.qitem')[4].click()); console.log("queue fallback element.click() used"); }
await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
const sel = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const s = document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel');
  const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/.test(x.innerText));
  return { queue: (document.querySelector('.qitem.active')||{}).innerText, model: s.options[s.selectedIndex].text, onclick: b.getAttribute('onclick') };
});
console.log("SELECTED:", JSON.stringify(sel));

const before = await page.evaluate(() => (window.__rcaCalls || []).length);
try { await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Investigate Root Cause/ }).click({ timeout: 5000 }); console.log("investigate native click OK"); }
catch (e) { await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/.test(x.innerText)).click()); console.log("investigate fallback element.click() used"); }

let engine = null, elapsed = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000); elapsed += 2;
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const t = document.getElementById('report').innerText; const m = t.match(/Engine:[^\n]*/);
    return { engine: m ? m[0] : null, calls: (window.__rcaCalls || []).length };
  });
  if (st.calls > before && st.engine) { engine = st.engine; console.log("ENGINE APPEARED AFTER ~" + elapsed + "s"); break; }
}
console.log("RCA CALLS (all):", await page.evaluate(() => JSON.stringify(window.__rcaCalls || [])));
console.log("ENGINE VERBATIM:", engine);
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('#report *')].find(e => /^Engine:/.test(e.textContent.trim()) && e.children.length === 0);
  if (t) t.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
});
await page.waitForTimeout(600);
console.log("---- FULL REPORT TEXT ----");
console.log(await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('report').innerText));
console.log(/Engine:\s*llm\s*·\s*nvidia\//.test(engine||"") ? "PASS: Engine is llm + NVIDIA model" : "FAIL: not llm -> " + engine);
